title: Reset theme is one undoable step that keeps edits, overrides and locks
intent: A guided edit, a token override and a group lock survive as one draft: Reset theme returns the Neutral preset, and a single Undo restores all three, in the controls and in the painted preview.

storage.reason: Production writes the draft through the studio's own autosave within one reload journey; the context starts with empty storage and no URL fragment and is closed afterwards.

preconditions: Storage and the URL fragment are empty, so the studio opens on the Neutral preset with no history.
Below 840px, open Edit theme and pick a group from the drawer selector. Desktop groups expand through Edit Density or Edit Color.

steps.action: Expand Density and choose Roomy in Density preset.
steps.expect: Roomy is pressed and the preview's --ult-space-1 changes from its stock value.

steps.action: Open Color token overrides and commit #ff0000 to --ult-color-accent.

steps.expect: Lock Density is pressed and the status reads 1 locked group.
The autosaved draft restores the edit, override and lock; undo history starts empty.
The Neutral preset returns: Cosy is pressed, Lock Density is not, and the preview shows stock spacing and accent.
Roomy, the #ff0000 override and the Density lock are back, in the controls and in the preview.

steps.action: Production only: close the mobile editor, open Export theme, acknowledge any failed pairings, and copy the install command. Fetch its registry URL.
steps.expect: The built worker returns the same stylesheet and editable draft as the file export, preserving the override and Density lock; the export fits both viewports.
